given: the home table is showing rows of stock by location
when: the warehouse team member reads the quantity column
then: each quantity value is right-aligned within its column so the digits line up for at-a-glance scanning

independence.rationale: AC1 asserts that the rows and their SKU/location/quantity values appear at all; AC2 asserts the distinct visual outcome that quantities are right-aligned. Alignment can break (left-aligned digits) while rows still render correctly, and rows can be missing while any single quantity that does render is right-aligned, so each fails independently.
